Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Senior Resident post in Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in Interview, and the interview process is scheduled to start on 17 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Senior Resident posts at Ambedkar Nagar Hospital?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Senior Resident in Ambedkar Nagar Hospital?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Resident post is Rs. 67700 per month, corresponding to Level-11.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Senior Resident recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application for the Senior Resident posts at Ambedkar Nagar Hospital is Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What are the qualifications required for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an MBBS with a PG Degree/Diploma or equivalent in the concerned specialty recognized by MCI and be registered with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q8. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled for Ambedkar Nagar Hospital?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for Senior Resident posts is scheduled to start on 17 August 2026 and end on 19 August 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is Ambedkar Nagar Hospital located?
faq.answer: Ambedkar Nagar Hospital is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with pincode 110062.
